name: Warcraft Reborn Mystic Enchant Murder Rush gives or refreshes Sprint on a kill and adds 10% damage while Sprint lasts
contract: Murder Rush 1180880 (enchant 1237001): "Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor gives you Sprint for 5 seconds. If Sprint is already active, its duration is fully refreshed. In addition, while Sprint is active you deal 10% more damage." Reported in #10890: the kill made the Sprint sound but gave no buff and no movement speed.

The kill proc cast only 1180881, whose duration effect lengthens rank 1 Sprint and does nothing without it, and whose 10% damage aura had no effect type. Now a kill without Sprint gives the rogue's Sprint for 5 sec, a kill during Sprint refreshes it to its full duration, and the 10% damage aura (1180881) is up exactly while Sprint is.

Checked: Sprint (1102983) and its 50% run speed after a kill, its 5 sec duration, 10% more Sinister Strike damage against a same-run baseline, the damage aura ending with Sprint, a cast Sprint lasting its 15 sec (no 30 sec extension), and a kill refreshing a 15 sec Sprint back to full.
